addition.item: Display options in the Content tab, as in YOOtheme's own elements: show or hide the text, images, icons and links of all items without deleting them, e.g. logos only. Linked items without their text keep it as a name for screen readers.

fix.item: Links work on every item on screen. The copies that fill the row were not clickable, so with few items most of the links on screen did nothing. Copies stay hidden from screen readers and are skipped by the Tab key.
Linked items fade slightly on hover and show a focus ring for keyboard users.

change.item: The pause button's Pause and Play labels come from the plugin's language files.

addition.item: Lucide Icon fields, with Icon Pro installed: Lucide icons for the items and the separator.

First release: text, icons or logos scrolling without end, to the left or right or in two rows going opposite ways. Speed in pixels per second, pause or slow down on hover, faded edges, separators, outline text, grey logos that turn to color on hover, and a tilted ribbon with a background. Visitors who prefer less motion get a row they can scroll themselves.
